name: Sangoulé Lamizana
role: President of Upper Volta from 1966 to 1980
contribution: An Upper Voltan military officer who served as the President of Upper Volta, in power from 3 January 1966, to 25 November 1980.

checks.lead: Aboubacar Sangoulé Lamizana (31 January 1916 – 26 May 2005) was an Upper Voltan military officer who served as the President of Upper Volta (since 1984 renamed Burkina Faso), in power from 3 January 1966, to 25 November 1980. He held the additional position of Prime Minister from 8 February 1974, to 7 July 1978.
